scenario.topic: Pick the office plant arrangement for the reception area

options.name: Tall Snake Plants with White Pebble Base
options.upside: Requires minimal watering and air purifies the space.
options.concern: Tall height may partially block sightlines at the reception desk.

options.name: Mixed Succulent Garden in Rectangular Planter
options.upside: Compact and colorful arrangement that fits well in small spaces.
options.concern: May require occasional trimming to maintain neat appearance.

options.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig Trees in Modern Ceramic Pots
options.upside: Adds a bold, sculptural element to the reception area.
options.concern: Requires more care and is toxic if touched or ingested.

options.name: Boston Ferns in Hanging Planters
options.upside: Creates a lush, natural look without occupying floor space.
options.concern: Needs regular misting and humidity to stay healthy.

shared_context: The reception area needs a plant arrangement that fits a 6-foot-wide space, requires low maintenance, and complements a modern office style. The plants should tolerate indirect light and be safe for visitors and pets.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Office manager focused on creating a welcoming and functional reception space.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the plant arrangement requires minimal upkeep to avoid extra workload.

A.reason_for: Low maintenance and non-toxic, fits indirect light, and purifies air, ideal for busy reception.

B.reason_for: Very low maintenance and compact, fits well in the space with safe plants.
B.reason_against: Needs occasional trimming to keep neat, slightly less impactful visually.

C.reason_for: Adds bold style to modern office.
C.reason_against: Toxic and requires more care, which conflicts with low maintenance priority.

D.reason_for: Non-toxic and creates lush look without floor space use.
D.reason_against: Medium maintenance and needs regular misting, which is less ideal.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Facilities coordinator responsible for safety and aesthetics in shared spaces.
personas.private_goal: Choose plants that are safe for visitors and pets and enhance the modern style.

A.reason_for: Non-toxic and low maintenance, fits indirect light well.
A.reason_against: Tall plants might block sightlines, which could affect reception visibility.

B.reason_for: Safe, colorful, and very low maintenance, good for small spaces.
B.reason_against: Needs occasional trimming, which adds minor upkeep.

C.reason_against: Toxic if ingested, which is unsafe for visitors and pets.

D.reason_for: Non-toxic, fits modern style, and doesn’t occupy floor space, enhancing safety and aesthetics.

personas.background: Creative director passionate about bold design elements and visual impact.
personas.private_goal: Select a striking plant arrangement that complements the modern office vibe.

D.reason_for: Lush and natural look without floor space use.
D.reason_against: Medium maintenance and less striking compared to other options.
